description: This file defines a simple in-memory storage class for JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), allowing setting, overriding, and clearing of the token during runtime. It includes mechanisms to retrieve the current token, considering environment variables and session overrides.

classes.name: TokenStore
classes.description: A class managing JWT token storage with in-memory overrides, intended for temporary use and with plans for more secure storage in the future.

methods.name: jwt
methods.description: Getter that returns the current JWT token, considering overrides and environment variables.

methods.name: setJwt
methods.description: Sets or overrides the JWT token for the current session.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the session override, reverting to environment JWT if available.
